title: Federal Aviation Act – FAA Regulations (Quy định Hàng không Liên bang)
typeLabel: Quy định / Văn bản dưới luật

Federal Aviation Regulations (14 CFR).
Part 1: Definitions. Part 21: Certification (type certificates, airworthiness).
Part 61: Pilot certificates. Part 91: General operating rules.
Part 121: Operating requirements for airlines.
Part 135: Commuter and on-demand operations.
Part 107: Small unmanned aircraft (drones). FAA Reauthorization Act 2024.
